Our story

From pop-up to Saluda Ave.

Godspeed is Kailey Cunningham and Roger Caughman — two baristas who worked together behind the bar a few doors down, then set out to build a coffee shop with something for everyone.

  1. July 2024 — the first pop-upSlinging drinks out of Papa Jazz Record Shoppe's interim space at 747 Saluda.
  2. Next stop: 711 SaludaPop-up weekends with GrowCo at the Boyd Innovation Center.
  3. April 1, 2026 — open for goodBack at 747 Saluda Ave, in a former Starbucks renovated over several months.
  4. TodayOpening an hour earlier on weekdays, six months in — and still running drops and pop-ups.
